problems.title: GEMM shape
problems.statement: C = 64, H = W = 56, M = 128 filters of 3 × 3, stride 1, no padding.

problems.title: im2col blow-up
hints: X duplicates inputs up to K² times.
problems.solution: 401 KB versus 3.36 MB: 8.4× the input. Implicit GEMM avoids writing it.

problems.title: Intensity after lowering
problems.statement: The GEMM Y = W X above, FP16, assuming each matrix moves once.
problems.solution: About 101 FLOP/byte: compute-bound on tensor cores, which is why the lowering pays despite the copy.

problems.title: Batch
problems.statement: A batch of 32 images through the same layer.

options: Better: a wider N fills the GPU and reuses W more

problems.solution: 93,312 columns: big GEMMs run near peak, small ones don't.

problems.title: Backward GEMMs

options: col2im: scatter-add the K² copies back

problems.solution: Weight gradient (∂L/∂Y)Xᵀ, input gradient Wᵀ(∂L/∂Y) followed by col2im, a scatter-add.

problems.title: Coalescing in im2col
problems.statement: Thread-per-column versus thread-per-row mappings of X's writes.
problems.solution: 4 versus 32: the simulator showed coalescing 0.87 versus 0.18.

problems.title: Winograd
problems.statement: Winograd F(2×2, 3×3) computes a 2 × 2 output tile with 16 multiplies instead of 36.
problems.solution: 2.25×, at some cost in numerical accuracy (larger transforms amplify rounding).

problems.title: Padding and stride
problems.statement: Output size with padding p and stride s: Ho = ⌊(H + 2p − K)/s⌋ + 1.

problems.title: Implicit GEMM addressing
problems.statement: Implicit GEMM loads tile element (row r of X, column c) straight from the input.

parts.prompt: For r = (ch·K + ky)·K + kx and c = oy·Wo + ox, the input address is…

problems.solution: The tile loader computes this index instead of reading X: same GEMM, no materialised matrix.

problems.title: Layout
problems.solution: NHWC keeps the reduction dimension (channels) contiguous for vector loads into MMA tiles.
